title: Settings
subtitle: Configure your AutoGram application.
api_config_hint: Get API ID & API Hash from my.telegram.org. On desktop, credentials are stored encrypted in the local keychain. Do not share your hash with anyone.
language_desc: Select your preferred primary display language (English / Indonesian).
sidebar_layout_desc: Choose the sidebar navigation layout model that best fits your workflow preference.
sidebar_model_a_title: Model A — Smart Tabs + Quick Pin (Recommended)
sidebar_model_a_desc: Top fixed header for Saved Messages & Pinned Chips, followed by 3 Navigation Tabs (All, Drives, Chats) with spacious scroll area.
sidebar_model_b_desc: Pure 4-Tab navigation control (Pin, Home, Drive, Chat) right below location search input.
sidebar_model_c_desc: Classic layout with vertically stacked sections (Pinned, Recent, Drives, Chats) in one linear scroll pane.
startup_behavior_section_desc: Configure which workspace opens when AutoGram launches and manage your default Telegram account.
startup_mode_desc: Select where AutoGram lands immediately after application launch
startup_mode_launcher_desc: Show session selection hub to pick an account and workspace
startup_mode_drives_desc: Skip launcher and open Drives Workspace using default account
startup_mode_forwarder_desc: Skip launcher and open File Forwarder Suite using default account
startup_mode_last_desc: Re-open whichever workspace was active when last closed
default_account_desc: Primary account used for direct workspace startup and quick actions (2-way synced)
no_accounts_available: No accounts available. Please add an account in Accounts page.
credentials_saved: Credentials successfully saved in Rust Keychain!
cache_management_desc: The app stores temporary data locally (thumbnails, preview data, folder/sidebar history, and transient logs) to speed up navigation. Clear cache if you want to free up disk space or reload fresh data from Telegram.
custom_cache_location_desc: Customize physical folder for cache & temporary files to a drive/SSD with more free space.
custom_cache_fallback_warning: Custom folder is inaccessible (drive unmounted or folder deleted). Automatically fallen back to default directory.
custom_cache_migrate_modal_msg: You selected a new location for the cache directory:
custom_cache_migrate_option_move: Move Existing Cache to New Folder
custom_cache_migrate_option_move_desc: All existing cache & temporary files will be moved to the new folder in the background.
custom_cache_migrate_option_wipe_desc: Completely delete all old cache files and initialize a fresh cache directory.
custom_cache_reset_modal_msg: You are resetting the cache location back to the default directory:
custom_cache_reset_option_move: Move Cache Back to Default Folder
custom_cache_reset_option_move_desc: All existing cache & temporary files in the custom folder will be moved back to default in the background.
custom_cache_reset_option_wipe_desc: Reset setting to default and wipe old cache files for a fresh start.
custom_cache_progress_moving: Moving cache & temporary files to target location...
custom_cache_progress_wiping: Deleting old cache & initializing fresh directory...
custom_cache_progress_wait: Please wait while files are being processed...
custom_cache_success_reset: Cache directory successfully reset to default location!
custom_cache_error_action: Failed to update cache directory location.
cache_warning_exceed_limit: Warning: Current detected cache size ({{cacheSize}}) exceeds configured limit ({{limit}}) by {{excess}}. Pruning is recommended.
cache_warning_exceed_disk: Critical Warning: Detected cache size ({{cacheSize}}) exceeds available disk space ({{freeDisk}})! Please clear cache immediately.
cache_warning_low_disk: Disk Space Warning: Available disk space on this drive is critically low ({{freeDisk}} remaining).
cache_warning_limit_exceeds_disk: Info: Cache limit ({{limit}}) is set higher than available disk space ({{freeDisk}}). The limit will be effectively capped by physical disk capacity.
custom_limit_exceeds_disk_note: Note: Auto-prune quota limit is set to {{limit}}. Background auto-prune will run flexibly as cache grows toward the limit or physical disk capacity.
auto_prune_desc: Automatically prunes old cache periodically when exceeding limit (protects active files & transfers).
clear_cache_modal_msg: Are you sure you want to clear all local cache, thumbnail memory, and transient media data?
clear_cache_reset_config_option: Also reset app configuration & preferences to default
clear_cache_reset_config_help: Uncheck this to keep your saved app settings and preferences intact.
clear_cache_success_with_config: All cache cleared & app settings reset to default.
clear_cache_success_cache_only: All cache cleared successfully. App settings preserved.
purge_orphaned_sessions_desc: Cleans up leftover session files (.grammers.json / .session) from expired logins or interrupted setups.
purge_orphaned_none: No orphaned session files found. Storage is clean!
db_clear_desc: Wipes all uploaded file history, resume state, audit logs, and local scan cache. Use this if you want Transfer Manager to re-scan fresh via Telegram API to detect missing/deleted files at destination.
perf_subtitle: Configure acceleration levels for downloading, thumbnail loading, and card list rendering smoothness.
perf_tier_low_desc: Saves RAM & CPU usage. Small thumbnail batching (20 items per request).
perf_tier_mid_desc: Ideal balance of MTProto transfer speed & visual smoothness (32 batch).
perf_tier_high_desc: Maximum throughput for fast devices & networks (96 batch, 6 parallel streams).
proxy_subtitle: Configure SOCKS5/HTTP/MTProto routing, timeout & aggressive retry adjustments for slow networks/VPNs.
debug_subtitle: Full AutoGram & Telegram Drive log buffer
debug_desc: Captures worker + UI logs to debug repeating downloads, fallbacks, and transfer errors. Slightly slower when active. Do not share logs because they may contain file paths & names.
debug_hint_active: Chrome DevTools & Multi-Layer Logging ACTIVE (F12 ready)
debug_hint_inactive: DevTools & Extra Logs DISABLED (Open only for debugging)
debug_empty_buffer: Empty buffer. Run a download, upload, or open Media Studio to populate logs.
debug_tip: Jobs already running (drive-serve / downloads) need to be restarted after toggle for flags to take full effect.
backend_native_desc: Grammers is the active MTProto backend for Accounts, Sessions, media list, document preview, progressive video chunking, and seeking.
confirm_clear_cache_msg: Are you sure you want to clear all cache? All thumbnails, media previews, and local folder history will be cleaned.
confirm_clear_db_msg: Are you sure you want to clear the local database? All job history and local sessions will be wiped.
creds_save_success: ✓ Credentials saved to Rust Keychain successfully!
network_saved_reconnect: Network settings saved. Reconnect the Drive session to apply the proxy configuration.
backend_ownership_desc: Accounts, session switching, document previews, and progressive video are locked to Grammers + Rust so there is one connection source and one session owner.
proxy_unreachable_hint: Hint: Telegram DC is slow or unreachable. Consider enabling VPN Optimizer or Proxy.
cache_clear_success: Cache cleared successfully. Navigation will reload from scratch.
cache_clear_success_detail: Removed {{count}} cached entries and released {{size}}. Transfer Database was preserved.
cache_clear_error_title: Cache could not be fully cleared
cache_clear_error: Some active cache files are still in use. Close their previews and try again.
database_clear_success: ✓ Transfer database cleared successfully! Transfer history is now clean.
database_clear_error: Failed to clear the transfer database. Check the console logs for details.
auto_update_section_desc: Configure automatic update checks, background downloads, release channels, and installation preferences.
release_channel_desc: Choose whether to receive official stable releases or early preview beta builds
channel_stable_desc: Thoroughly tested releases for everyday production stability
channel_beta_desc: Get early access to upcoming features and experimental improvements
auto_check_updates_desc: Check GitHub releases periodically when AutoGram is running
auto_download_updates_desc: Download new versions quietly in the background and notify when ready to install
auto_install_exit_label: Install updates automatically on app exit
auto_install_exit_desc: Apply downloaded updates seamlessly when closing AutoGram
notify_update_desc: Display a notification banner when a new version is ready
update_ready_notice: Version {{version}} update has been downloaded and is ready to install.
cache_size_desc: Storage used by downloads, thumbnails, temporary buffers, and app data.
update_timeout_error: Update check timed out. Check your internet connection.
update_network_error: Could not reach GitHub. Check your internet connection.
cache_media_db_desc: Clear all indexed file metadata, scan history, and explorer snapshots in local SSD storage.
cache_media_db_cleared: Media index database & explorer snapshots cleared successfully!
cache_session_media_db_desc: Clear all indexed file metadata and explorer snapshots for this specific account.
cache_session_media_db_cleared: Media index for this session cleared successfully!
